statement.zh: 教科文将卡霍基亚土墩历史遗址列入世界遗产，强调密西西比文化巨型土墩与城市规划（UNESCO 198）。
statement.en: UNESCO lists Cahokia Mounds State Historic Site as World Heritage, emphasizing Mississippian monumental mounds and urban planning (UNESCO 198).
